title: Symptoms on the floor
hint: The icons operators pick, per machine class. A symptom that locks the machine marks it do-not-use at once, until a technician signs it safe.
classHint_one: A {class} station offers {count} symptom now: its own and those for every machine.
classHint_other: A {class} station offers {count} symptoms now: its own and those for every machine.

unsafe.label: Reporting {code} locks the machine
unsafe.askHint: Reporting it marks the machine do-not-use until a technician signs it safe (guard missing, electrical fault).
unsafe.newTitle: This symptom will lock the machine
unsafe.newBody: Every report of it stops the machine at once: the station takes no work on it until a technician checks it and signs it safe.

detail.label: {code} asks for words
detail.askHint: An "Other" symptom: the report is sent only with a few words about what is wrong.

used.hint_one: {count} report names this symptom: it can be taken off the floor, never deleted.
used.hint_other: {count} reports name this symptom: it can be taken off the floor, never deleted.
used.none: No report names this symptom yet.

icon.other: An icon this version does not draw

iconDialog.title: Icon · {code}
iconDialog.label: Icon
iconDialog.hint: Shown on the station's tile before the words.

state.emptyBody: Add the starter set and change it to your words, or add the first symptom.
state.emptyBodyView: Nobody has added a symptom yet: the stations can only describe a problem in words.

changed.title: Changed by someone else
changed.body: Another person changed the symptoms or the machine types since you opened them.

readOnly.title: You can view, not change
readOnly.body: The symptoms are the whole group's: keeping them needs the right to keep machines over every company.

held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved
held.badCode: A code is 2 to 40 capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter
held.codeTaken: The group already has this code
held.noWords: Say the symptom in Italian and in English
held.allOffered: Every symptom chosen is already offered
held.noneOffered: Every symptom chosen is already off the floor
held.narrowed: Show all symptoms, without a search, to move them: the order is the whole list's
held.noManage: Keeping the symptoms needs the right to keep machines over every company

keys.edit: Edit the words, switch, or open the icon
keys.title: Keys of the symptom list

newDialog.title: New symptom
newDialog.intro: The code and the machine type never change once added (reports keep them). The words are what operators read, each in their own language.
newDialog.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and underscores: BELT_SLIPS.
newDialog.forHint: A type's stations offer its own symptoms and those for every machine.

unsafeOff.title: Stop locking the machine for "{symptom}"?
unsafeOff.body: A report of {code} will no longer mark the machine do-not-use at once: it only reaches maintenance, and the machine stays as it is.
unsafeOff.still: Anyone at the station can still mark a machine unsafe on the report itself; only a technician signs it safe again.

problem.labelIt: Say the symptom in Italian: the Italian words are never empty
problem.labelEn: Say the symptom in English: the English words are never empty
problem.codeTaken: The group already has this code
problem.codeTakenRetired: The group already has this code, taken off the floor: offer it again instead of adding it
problem.tooMany: The group has the most symptoms it may keep: take some off the floor first
problem.stale: Someone changed this symptom since you read it: reload the list and try again
problem.code: A code is 2 to 40 capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter
problem.icon: Pick one of the icons offered
problem.classId: This machine type is retired or unknown: pick another
problem.invalid: The change was refused as it is
problem.forbidden: You may not change the symptoms
problem.gone: This symptom is no longer in the list: reload it
problem.signedOut: You were signed out: sign in again
problem.offline: Nexus Factory can't be reached: the value before is put back; try again when the connection is back
problem.read: Nexus Factory didn't answer: try again
problem.readForbidden: Seeing the symptoms needs the right to see the plant.

done.off_one: {count} symptom taken off the floor: {codes}. Reports keep the code.
done.off_other: {count} symptoms taken off the floor: {codes}. Reports keep the codes.
done.partly_one: {count} of {of} changed, then one was refused: the list was read again.
done.partly_other: {count} of {of} changed, then one was refused: the list was read again.
done.starter: From the starter set: {symptoms} symptoms and {classes} machine types added.
done.created: {code} added at the end of the list.

noAccess.title: You can't see the plant settings
noAccess.body: Plant settings need the right to see the plant (plant.view).
